##### Project general facts

Nad Al Sheba Gardens Phase 8 is a refined residential development that combines contemporary architecture with timeless elegance, creating a comfortable and sophisticated environment for modern living. The homes are thoughtfully designed with spacious layouts, abundant natural light, and a strong connection between indoor and outdoor spaces. High-quality materials, expansive windows, and private outdoor areas enhance the sense of space and create welcoming homes suited to both families and individuals.

The community offers a curated selection of amenities designed to support relaxation, wellbeing, and an active lifestyle. Landscaped parks, recreational areas, fitness facilities, and leisure spaces are thoughtfully integrated throughout the development, providing residents with opportunities to exercise, unwind, and connect with the community. The carefully planned environment creates a peaceful atmosphere while keeping everyday conveniences within easy reach.

The residences feature modern finishing using high-quality materials, with open layouts and expansive windows creating bright and inviting interiors. Thoughtful design details and private outdoor spaces further enhance comfort and functionality, offering a seamless indoor-outdoor living experience. The kitchens are equipped, while the residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Nad Al Sheba is located south of Dubai Creek, near the part of the city where indigenous people traditionally settle. Nad Al Sheba is close to Al Quoz, Silicon Dubai Oasis, Ras Al Khor industrial area and Al Markada. Properties here include villas, apartments and serviced apartments. A rich legacy awaits in a setting that resonates with all those who know the area.

The serene greenery of Nad Al Sheba is one of the city’s most covetable locations. A mere ten minutes from Downtown Dubai, this luxurious community has easy access to the Meydan Racetrack and many other premium leisure and lifestyle experiences. The Dubai International Airport and all major highways also lie within arm’s reach of Nad Al Sheba’s enviable location.

Nad Al Sheba Gardens is strategically located to give you the utmost in a privacy-focused lifestyle while connecting you to the best of Dubai’s city life. It’s a space built around carefully curated amenities. All this and more makes Nad Al Sheba Gardens a community tailored to truly nurture your inner and outer growth for today and future generations to come.
